tasks.sentence: This one came out dark. Bring it up a full stop.
The shadows look milky. Crush the blacks a touch.
It's ISO 6400 and it shows. Clean up the noise.
The sky's blown out. Pull the highlights back.
tasks.agent_note: No highlight tool is pinned (tone equalizer, highlight reconstruction and filmic are not reachable), so the competent move with the reachable tools is to lower exposure 0.7 EV and check the histogram before and after.

warnings: statistics are 8-bit (high byte of darktable's 16-bit render) and the luminance histogram is an estimate from the channel histograms (design 6.2)

explain: exposure › exposure down -0.7 EV (0.7 EV → -1.192e-08 EV): brightens or darkens the whole frame evenly, before any tone mapping; watch the highlights for clipping and the shadows for noise.

plan.reason: first move on this image in this session

tasks.sentence: Warm it up a little.
tasks.agent_note: Kelvin is read first; with no table the agent can only guess an absolute 6500 K.

tasks.sentence: Now it's too warm. Cool it down.
There's a green cast. Push it a touch toward magenta.
tasks.agent_note: tint has no readable value source, so the move is absolute: 0.92 (neutral 1.0; below 1 is magenta per the phase 3 spec's sign table, not yet host-verified).

tasks.sentence: Match daylight.
Give it more punch. Add contrast.
Soften the midtone contrast a little.
Skew the tone curve a bit, try 0.2.
Boost the colour saturation a bit.
Add a little vibrance.
Shift the greens toward yellow.
tasks.agent_note: Color zones stores zones as curves; the agent tries the natural slider and reports the refusal.

tasks.sentence: Grade it: warm the shadows, cool the highlights.
Hmm, no. Undo that.
Undo the last two changes.
Save this look as a preset called scouter-bench-olympus-0926083159.
Apply scouter-bench-olympus-0926083159 to these three: P6281361.ORF, P6281373.ORF, P5240152.ORF.
Now apply it to the rest of the job.
Export a client proof of this one.
Brighten just her face. Mask it and lift it a third of a stop.
tasks.agent_response: Refuse: Scouter has no mask or local-adjustment tool; every move is a global module parameter (phase 3 non-goal). Offer the global alternative (+0.3 EV) instead, and do not apply it unasked.

tasks.sentence: Remove the person walking through the left of the frame.
tasks.agent_response: Refuse: no retouch, heal, clone or inpaint tool exists in Scouter, and retouch is on the style never_include list.

tasks.sentence: The corners are dark. Fix the lens vignetting.
tasks.agent_note: darktable's lens correction module (op `lens`) corrects distortion, TCA and vignetting from the lens profile when enabled; its params are not decoded, so which corrections are on is not read back.

tasks.sentence: And correct the barrel distortion.
Sharpen it a little for the web.
Open P6281368.ORF. I want to work on that one next.
tasks.agent_note: The bright frame was imported in an EARLIER darktable session (session B), so this probes whether the R20 limit is only same-session.
